targets.authors: Singh, T., Moeller, B., Koch, I., & Frings, C.
targets.title: May I have your attention please: Binding of attended but response-irrelevant features.
targets.evidence_quote: In order to test this possibility, the present study implements the same design as Experiment 1 of Singh et al. ( 2018 ) with the exception that instead of word stimuli, picture stimuli were used.
targets.outcome_quote: Taken together, the findings of the present study replicate those of Singh et al. ( 2018 ), indicating that even with picture stimuli, valence related binding effects are modulated by attention allocation.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The authors state an overall replication verdict; the new picture sample re-tests the published word-stimulus finding.
